segments.he: ע"פ מ"ש רבינו ז"ל ע"פ באר חפרוה שרים וכו' ע"ש היטב. (בלק"ת סי' ע"ב). והכלל שעיקר התחי' שיהי' לעתיד יהי' רק להשפלות שהשפלות של כ"א הוא יהי' נחי' ויקום בתחי' כי עיקר החים נצחיים של לעתיד יהי' רק להשפלות של כ"א וא' ע"ש היטב וחיים נצחיים הנ"ל זוכין ע"י בושה שהוא בחי' תשובה שזוכין לזאת הבושה ע"י ביאורי התורה שזוכין ע"י התנוצצות המוחין שמתנוצצים ע"י הסתלכותשמסתכל בו הצדיק האמ תכשזוכין לראות א"ע עמו ע"ש כ"ז היטב. וכשזוכין לבושה אזי מתביישין אפילו להושיט האוכל לפיו כי מאן דאכיל דלאו דילי' בהית לאסתכולי באפי' וכו'. וע"י הבושה זוכין לתשובה שהוא בחי' חיים נצחיים ועיקר החים נצחים הוא רק להשפלות שהשפלות נחי' וזוכין לשפלות של משה וכו' וכו'. ע"ש היטב היטב:

segments.en:
knowledge of Him, blessed-be-He, is drawn through the

bitul mentioned above in the aspect of

ratzo va-shov [running and returning], through

which, by means of the reshimu mentioned above,

light shines into one's da'as [knowledge/mind]

to know that Hashem is G-d and all is entirely good etc., as above; and as is

explained at the conclusion of the Torah-teaching mentioned above regarding the

saying of our Sages of blessed memory: that in the future the Holy Blessed One

will make a circular dance [machol] for the righteous in the Time to Come,

and each one will point with his finger and declare,

“This is Hashem for Whom we have hoped”

etc. — and from there all the Torah flows, as above.

And the essential sum of all the Torah and mitzvos is to sanctify the

body so that it will be a prepared vessel to receive the light of the

reshimu mentioned above. For when the body is blemished

through any transgression, G-d protect us, it then cannot nullify itself properly;

and even if at times it prevails more and does nullify itself, it is only for a very

brief instant; and moreover, after returning from the

bitul, the body is unable to receive the light of the

reshimu on account of its blemish — and then the

reshimu passes and departs from him immediately, and

he forgets Him, blessed-be-He, G-d protect us. Therefore Hashem blessed-be-He

commanded us all the mitzvos of the Torah, in order to sanctify our bodies

through them, so that we can receive the reshimu

mentioned above and bind it within our bodies well and always remember Him,

blessed-be-He.

And therefore, in truth, the complete perfection of attaining knowledge of His

blessed Divinity is merited precisely [dayka]

by the great tzadikim who have sanctified themselves

properly, and have sealed and closed their eyes completely from the

cheyzu d'hai alma [the illusory sight of this world],

and who are pure and holy and separated and removed from all the desires of this

world — even those that are permitted — to the ultimate extreme; and

only they merit attainments of Divinity through the

reshimu of the bitul

mentioned above, because their bodies are exceedingly, exceedingly pure, enabling

them to receive the light of the reshimu in fullness

and perfection, as above. But the Blessed Name, blessed-be-He, had compassion upon

us and gave us the Torah through Moses — through which every single person can

remember Him, blessed-be-He, by fulfilling the mitzvos of the Torah at the

very least, through which his body is sanctified and he can receive some sparkling

[hitnoztzus] from the radiance of the

reshimu mentioned above.

((And see regarding this elsewhere.))

[The sparkling received is] according to his [spiritual] level, according to his

fulfillment of the Torah.

And this is the aspect of the mitzvah of

milah, which is the foremost

mitzvah [mitzvah rishonah], which is to remove the

orlah, which is the

zuhamas ha-nachash, so that one can bind within one's

body the light of the reshimu mentioned above. And

this is the aspect of the mitzvah of

milas avadim — those who are his monetary

acquisition [kinyan kaspo] — in order to remove the

orlah of the

segments.he: ויש לדקד בדברי רבינו ז"ל במאמר הנ"ל. מפני מה תפס דייקא ענין האכילה שע"י הבושה מתביישין בעצמן אפילו להושיט המאכל לפיו כנ"ל מה ענין אכילה דייקא לבושה הנ"ל. כי באמת כל דברי רבינו ז"ל הם כולם דברי אלקים חיםי ונאמרו בדקדוק גדול מאד. ויש רזין עילאין כמה וכ"פ בכל מאמר ומאמר ובפרט בענין קישור הדברים. כיבכל דיבור יש כוונה שלימה ואין להאריך בזה כאן:
segments.en:
zuhamas ha-nachash that grips in the

cheyzu d'hai alma, from his monetary acquisition.

For the primary grip of the zuhamas ha-nachash, which

is the cheyzu d'hai alma, takes hold most intensely in

mammon

[money/wealth] — for

“silver answers everything”

[Ecclesiastes 10:19] — and within it

are encompassed all the vanities and desires of the follies of this world. For

within mammon, all thirty-nine

melachos [creative labors] have their grip —

those which were drawn forth from the sin of Adam the first man through the counsel

of the serpent. And therefore there is where the primary

asiyah [doing/making] and

avdus [servitude/labor] reside, being the sum of

all thirty-nine melachos — which are the

precise opposite of the bitul mentioned above.

For the bitul means to nullify the body completely

so that it has no sensation whatsoever — even of the most necessary [bodily

functions] — to the point where one would not move one's eyelids, would not

move one's lips, would not stir any limb at all, as cited [in the traditions of

the tzadikim]. Whereas the

asiyah and avdus of all

the thirty-nine melachos — all of which are

[driven by] the desire for mammon — are the

precise opposite of bitul in every respect.

And therefore one must sanctify all the more the thirty-nine

melachos, so that they should be in the aspect of

meleches ha-mishkan [the sacred labor of the

Sanctuary] ((as explained elsewhere)) —

in order to remove from them the zuhamas ha-nachash

that has gripped them most intensely, so that it should not prevent him from binding

the reshimu mentioned above within his heart when he

returns from the bitul; for then, upon returning

from the bitul, the aspect of

cheyzu d'hai alma overpowers anew with even greater

force, in the manner of two people battling one another etc. And as is explained

there regarding the intensification of yisoorim

[sufferings], G-d protect us — see it there. For it is all one: for the

cheyzu d'hai alma — which are the vanities and

desires of this world — are themselves the primary source of suffering

[yisoorim] of the soul, and from them come all the

bodily yisoorim as well, G-d protect us.

Therefore, one must circumcise the slave who is his monetary acquisition

[kinyan kaspo], in order to remove the orlah

of the zuhamas ha-nachash from the slave who is his

monetary acquisition, wherein is the primary grip [of the

zuhamas ha-nachash], as above — so that [the

slave] can receive the light of the reshimu and bind

it within his heart when he returns from the bitul,

so that the orlah and the

zuhama [filth] of his slave — his monetary

acquisition — should not impede him. For the primary grip of the

cheyzu d'hai alma — the

zuhamas ha-nachash — is in

mammon, wherein is the primary

avdus, as above. And therefore the slave is

obligated in numerous mitzvos, and every mitzvah that a woman

is obligated in, a slave is also obligated in — for one must sanctify the

slave who is his monetary acquisition through the mitzvos of the Torah

— and [this is] for [the slave's] own benefit — and to circumcise him

specifically for the purpose of [his] enslavement [l'shem avdus], in

order to nullify the zuhamas ha-nachash from his

monetary acquisition, wherein is the primary grip, as above.

And therefore, when the slave of a Kohen [priest] is

circumcised, he is permitted to eat of the

terumah [priestly tithe-portion] and of the

chazeh va-shok [chest and thigh portions of offerings] — something

that a [non-priestly] Israelite himself is forbidden [to eat]. For Hashem

blessed-be-He sanctified us through His mitzvos so that we could recognize

Him through the radiance of the reshimu mentioned

above — and for this reason we must sanctify our eating, not eating forbidden

things: nevailos [improperly slaughtered animals] and

treifos [forbidden foods] and impure species, in which the

zuhamas ha-nachash has its greatest grip; for through

consuming them the body is blemished and cannot receive the light of the radiance

mentioned above.

And just as impure things are forbidden for this reason, so conversely He also

forbade for us numerous holy things that are forbidden to eat on account of the

excess of their holiness — such as terumah and

sacrificial kodashim to a

zar [non-priest] — the reason for their

prohibition being that [the zar] should not receive the vitality drawn

through eating in a manner of excess light that would cause the

sh'viras kelim [shattering of the vessels], G-d

protect us. For the primary drawing of the light mentioned above is through the

rectification of the vessels, as above. Therefore the

zar is forbidden to eat

terumah and kodashim on account of excess

light, for one who is not a Kohen lacks the capacity

to draw and bind the light that flows through eating

terumah and kodashim, for it constitutes

excess light as far as he is concerned. But the slave — who is the monetary

acquisition [kinyan kaspo] of the

Kohen — can eat

terumah and kodashim like his master the

Kohen, for he is included within him [the

Kohen], since he is the Kohen's monetary

acquisition [kaspo] — where is the primary completion of the

rectification of the vessels. For the primary rectification of the vessels is

accomplished by sanctifying mammon from the grip of

the zuhamas ha-nachash that has gripped [it] through

the thirty-nine melachos.

For the Kohanim's service is in the Temple

[Beis ha-Mikdash] and in the Sanctuary [Mishkan] — where

is the primary rectification of all thirty-nine

melachos, as is explained elsewhere. And therefore

they [the Kohanim] atone for all the transgressions

that arise from the zuhamas ha-nachash; and the

primary [vehicle of] atonement [kaparah] is through

mammon — for one who has sinned must bring from

his mammon and his money a

korban [offering] commensurate with the sin. And through this the

segments.he: והענין כי עיקר תיקון האכילה שתהיה בקדושה הוא ע"י הבושה שהו אבחי' תשובה שעל ידה זוכין לחיים נצחים דהיינו שהשפלות נחי' וזוכין לשפלות כי עיקר התכלית הוא השפלות כי עיקר התכלי תהוא להכיר הבורא ית' וא"א לדעת אותו ית' שזהו עיקר החים הנצחיים כ"א ע"י השפלות וע"כ לעתיד שיחי' חים נצחיים ויכירו וידעו אותו ית' שזהו עיקר שעשוע עוה"ב ע"כ עיקר החים הנצחיים יהי' רק להשפלות כנ"ל. כי א"א להשיגו ית' ולדעתו אותו ית' כ"א כשזוכה להיות בבחי' אין ממש בתכלית השפלות באמת והנה כשהאדם אוכל ע"י האכילה נתגדל החומר והישות וכשנתגדל ונתרבה החומר והישות אזי יכול ח"ו להתעלם ולהתמעט אצלו בחי' האין שהוא בחי' שפלות. וזה שחששה התורה פן תאכל ושבעת וכ' ורם לבבך ושכחת את ה' וכו' כי ע"י האכילה נתגדל החומר והישות שמזה יחכול לבא לידי גאוה ורום לבב שהוא בחי' ישות היפך בחי' אין ושףלות וע"י הרום לבב יכול לשכוח אותו ית' כי א"א לידע ממנו ית' כ"א ע"י שפלות בחי' אין כנ"ל. וזהו פן תאכל ושבעת ורם לבבך ושכחת וכו' כנ"ל. ואכילה כזו זה בחי' עץ הדעת טו"ר שפגם בו אדה"ר שנאמר בו ביום אכלך ממנו מות תמות כי ע"י אכילה כזו שעל ידה בא גסות ורום לבב שעל ידה שוכחין אותו ית' כנ"ל. זה בחי' מיתה ח"ו היפך חיים נצחיים. כי עיקר החים נצחיים של לעתיד הוא לדעת אותו ית' שזה החים הוא רק להשפלות כנ"ל אבל ע"י גסות א"א לידע ממנו ית' שזהו בחי' מיתה מאחר שאין יודע מחי החיים ית'. וע"כ צריכין לאכול בקדושה באופן שע"י האכילה יזכה לשפלות שזהו עיקר החיים כנ"ל. ואכילה כזו הוא ע"י בושה ע"י שזוכין לבושה ע"י התורה הנ"ל. שעי"ז זוכין לאכול עם בושה כי מתביישין אפילו להושיט המאכל לפיו וכשאוכלין בבושה שהוא בחי'תשובה שעל ידה זוכין לחיםי נצחיים בחי' שפלות נמצא שנמשך ע"י אכילה זו בחי' שפלות יותר וזה בחי' אכילת הצדיק בחי' צדיק אוכל לשובע נפשו כי באמת עיקר האכילה הוא בשביל החיים כי עיקר החיםי של האדם הוא ע"י האכילה. אבל כשאוכל בגשמיות בלי בושה שאזי נתגדל החומר והישות ובא לגסות הרוח ושכח אותו ית' ח"ו כנ"ל. אזי אדרבא הוא מת ח"ו ע"י אכילתו בחי' כי ביום אכלך ממנו מות תמות כנ"ל) ואזי הוא בחי' רשעים בחייהם קרויים מתים כי עיקר החים הוא רק לדעת אותו ית' שזהו רק ע"י שפלות כנ"ל. וע"כ עיקר תיקון האכילה דקדושה הוא ע"י בושה שהוא בחי' תשובה בחי' חיים נצחיים של עוה"ב בחי' שפלות וכשאוכל בבחינה זו בבחי' בושה שמתבייש בעצמו להושיט המאכל לפיו אזי ע"י אכילה כזו נתוסף לו חיים באמ תבחי' חיים נצחיים שזהו עיקר החים דהיינו בחי' שפלות כנ"ל. ועיקר הבושה שבה תלוי תיקון האכילה דקדושה הוא באה ע"י ביאורי התורה שזוכין ע"י התנוצצות המוחין שמקבלין מהסתכלות של הצדיק כמבואר שם וזה בא ע"י שמירת הברית וכו' ע"ש. וזהו בחי' פגם אכילת עץ הדעת טו"ר דהיינו בחי' האכילה שאינה נמשכת מביאורי התורה שבאים ממוחין זכים וכו' כנ"ל. שע"י אכילה כזו זוכין לחים נצחים וכו' ע"י הבושה וכו' כנ"ל. אבל בחי' אכילת עה"ד טו"ר הוא בחי' האכילה שנמשכים ממוחין מבולבלים שבאים מפגם הברית הברית שעי"ז נסתלק הבושה כי פגם הברית היא פגם הבושה כיאין בושת אלא במקום עריין. וכשפוגם בברי תהוא מסלק הבושה מעל פניו והאכילה שהיא ח"ו בבחי' אכילת עץ הדעת טו"ר הוא בחי' שאוכל בלי בושה שזאת האכילה נמשכת ממוחין מבולבלים בחי' עץ הדעת טו"ר שהם היפך ביאורי התורה הנ"ל וכו' כנ"ל. וע"כ נאמר באכילה זו כי ביום אכלך ממנו וכו' היפך חים אמתיים חיים נצחיים כנ"ל:
segments.en:
Kohen atones for him, because in the Temple

[Beis ha-Mikdash] there is the primary

bitul, and there the light of the

reshimu mentioned above illuminates well — for

the reception of the radiance of the light of the

reshimu mentioned above is according to the holiness

of the person, the place, and the time. Therefore the slave who is the monetary

acquisition [kinyan kaspo] of a

Kohen can eat of

terumah and kodashim, for the primary

perfection of the Kohen is that he rectifies

mammon from the

zuhamas ha-nachash, until all the objects of the

world — which are all encompassed within

mammon — can receive the light of the

reshimu mentioned above. And this is the primary

rectification, as above.

And this is [the meaning of]:

“And you shall love Hashem your G-d with all your

heart, and with all your soul, and with all your

me'odecha”

[Deuteronomy 6:5] —

which is placed immediately following the verse:

“Shema Yisrael — Hashem is our G-d, Hashem is One”

— which is the primary aspect of

bitul: to nullify oneself and become included in

His Oneness with mesiras nefesh

[total self-devotion] for the sanctification of the [Divine] Name, as our Sages

of blessed memory stated. And afterwards one says:

“And you shall love Hashem your G-d with all your

heart, and with all your soul, and with all your me'odecha”

— which refers to mammon, as is known —

meaning to bind the light of the reshimu within

one's heart, one's soul, and one's me'odecha, which is one's

mammon, wherein is encompassed all the desire of

this world — [meaning] to nullify everything for the love of Hashem,

blessed-be-He. For the primary binding of the light of the

reshimu is when one also purifies and sanctifies

one's mammon from the

cheyzu d'hai alma, wherein is the primary grip of

the zuhamas ha-nachash, as above. And there [in

mammon] is the primary rectification of the vessels — for the

primary formation of the aspect of the vessels comes through the aspect of

smol, gevuros, tzimtzumim [left side, severities, contractions] as is

known — and this is the aspect of mammon,

the aspect of “and in her left hand,

wealth” etc.

[Proverbs 3:16, regarding the Torah].

And this is the aspect of the sanctity of Shabbos, which is the

tachlis [ultimate purpose], the aspect of the

World to Come — for then all the thirty-nine

melachos are nullified. And then is the primary

perfection of da'as [knowledge/mind] to know Him,

blessed-be-He, through the light of the

reshimu mentioned above — because then all

thirty-nine melachos that are [rooted] in

mammon are nullified, as above. And therefore

milah [performed at its proper time] overrides

Shabbos — for it is impossible to receive the sanctity of Shabbos, which is

the tachlis, except by first removing the

orlah etc., as above.

And this is [the meaning of]:

“And it shall come to pass, because

[ekev] you hearken to these statutes [ha-mishpatim]”

etc. [Deuteronomy 7:12]. For the entire book of

Mishneh Torah [Deuteronomy] is [a record of how] Moses admonishes Israel

to fulfill the Torah and bind it well within their hearts so that it should not be

forgotten and not pass from them — that is, the aspect mentioned above: that

they should bind the light of the radiance of the

reshimu mentioned above, from which all the Torah

[flows], and bind it well within their hearts through engaging in Torah and

mitzvos. And therefore he repeats and reviews all the Divine sparklings of

Divinity that they had witnessed at the time of the Giving of the Torah and at the

time of the Splitting of the Sea etc., as is explained in the preceding books [of

the Torah] — as it is written in [the portion of]

Va'eschanan:

“You have been shown to know that Hashem is the

G-d” etc.

[Deuteronomy 4:35]. And similarly, he there

repeats and reviews all the great and awesome deeds of Hashem that He performed at

the Giving of the Torah, when He spoke with them face to face etc. And afterwards

[Moses] declared: “Shema Yisrael — Hashem is our G-d, Hashem is

One” — which is the mitzvah of

Kriyas Shema every day, that every single member of

Israel is obligated to recite Kriyas Shema every day

with mesiras nefesh [total self-devotion] in order

to be included in the One. And therefore, during

Kriyas Shema, one closes one's eyes — in order

to be included in the tachlis, which is entirely One;

and it is impossible to become included there except through shutting one's eyes

well, as above. And afterwards [Moses] declared:

“And you shall love” etc., as above

— “and you shall bind them as a sign upon

your arm” etc. — and all the subsequent portions, in all of

which he admonishes them to fulfill the Torah, in order to bind the sparkling of

His blessed Divinity within their hearts, as above. And connected to all of this

is: “And it shall come to pass, because

[ekev] you hearken” etc. — the word

ekev [literally: heel] refers to the aspect of

ragley [feet/heels], meaning: when you shall have

bound the Torah within your hearts to such a degree that you hear it [reverberating]

within the heels and feet — which is the aspect of

mammon, which is called

regel [foot], as it is written:

“and all the substance that was at their feet

[b'ragleyhem]”

[Genesis 7:3; and cf. Rashi on Numbers 22:22];

and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: this refers to a person's

mammon that keeps him standing on his feet —

then [will follow]:

“and Hashem your G-d will guard for you the

covenant and the kindness” etc. For then you will have vessels to

segments.he: וזה בחי' איסור ערלה כי שלש שני ערלה הם מחמת פגם עץ הדעת כידוע ומובא במדרש מי יגלה עפר מעיניך וכו' והלא בניך ממתינים שלש שנים כוו' ואז בשלש שנים הראשונים שאז שורה הרע של עץ הדעת אז אסור לגמרי לאכול מהפירות וע"כ נקראים בשם ערלה זה בחי' גסות החומר שבא ע"י אכילה שאינה בקדושה בחי' אכילת עץ הדעת כנ"ל. כי גסות הוא בחי' תוספת וריבוי ויתרון כ"שומשלם על יתר עושה גאוה וכמובא בפרש"י כי גסות הוא בחי' ריבוי הישות וזה בחי' ערלה שע"י אכילה כזה נתרבה ונתוסף חומר על החומר עד שנעשה בבחי' ערל ממש כמו הערלה ממש שהוא תוספת על בשר קודש והיא חופפת על הברית קודש ואוטמת אותו כמו כן ממש ע"י אכילה כזו נתגדל חומר על חומר עד שנתערל ונאטם ממש ע"י הגסות שהוא בחי' ישות ורבוי ותוספת שעי"ז שוכח אותו ית' כנ"ל. וע"כ אסור לנו לאכול הפירות בשלש שני ערלה כנ"ל עד השנה הרביעית שאז מתחיל להתגלות הטוב כידוע אזי מותרים לאכול הפירות. אבל עדיין צרייכם תיקון כדי לבררם מבחי' אכילת עץ הדעת לבחי' אכילה דקדשוה שהוא ע"י בושה שזוכין על ידה לשפלות וכו' כנ"ל. וע"כ צריכין להעלות הפירות לירושלים, ירושלים הוא בחי' יראה שלם בחי' בחי' ירא בשת כי יראה הוא בושה כידוע. וע"כ שם בירושלים שם צריכין להעלות הפירות בתחילת תיקונם כי שם זוכין לאוכלם בבחינת בושה שזהו עיקר התיקון שלהם ושם זוכין לבחינת שפלות כי שם בירושלים שם הבי תהמקדש ששם האבן שתיה שהיא הנקודה של העולם וזאת הנקודה הוא בחי' אין שמשם נמשך הכל כידוע וע"כ נקודה זו הוא בביהמ"ק שהוא בחי' מוחין כמבואר במאמר הנ"ל. כי ע"י המוחין שהם בחי' ביאורי התורה על ידם זוכין לנקודה זו שהוא בחי' אין כנ"ל וע"כ שם בביהמ"ק ובירושלים שם עיקר תיקון האכילה דקודשה שעיקר תיקונה ע"י בושה כדי לזכות ע"י האכילה שאוכלין שם לבחי' חחים נצחיים בחי' שפלות בחי' אין שהוא בחי' האבן שתיה שמשם הושתת העולם כנ"ל. וזה בחי' סלע ישכון ויתלונן משם חפר אוכל שפירש שם רבינו ז"ל במאמר הנ"ל פסוק זה לענין ביאורי התורה וכו' ע"ש. וזהו סלע הוא בחי' האבן שתיה שהוא בחי' שפלות בחי' אין בחי' זו זוכין ע"י ביאורי התורה כנ"ל שהם בחי' באר וכו' שזה ג"כ בחי' סלע כנ"ל. כי כולו חד כי זה תלוי בזה כנ"ל כי שפלות בחי' אבן שתיה נמשך ע"י ביאורי התורה שהם בחי' באר וסלע כנ"ל. שעיקר תיקון האכילה בא משם בחי' משם חפר אוכל לשון וחפרה הלבנה בחי' אכילה עם בושה שזה עיקר תקון האכילה כנ"ל. ע"ש היטב במאמר הנ"ל ודו"ק היטב היטב:

For the primary rectification of the vessels is accomplished when one rectifies the

mammon, wherein is the totality of all the desires

of the cheyzu d'hai alma, as above.

And therefore [Moses] called the Torah here

mishpatim [literally: judgments / laws], as it is

written: “And it shall come to pass, because you

hearken to these ha-mishpatim” etc. For

mishpat is a term also connoting

yisoorim [sufferings/afflictions], as Rashi explained

in Isaiah, that mishpat serves in three different

usages etc. For the primary reception of the Torah comes through

yisoorim, through which one closes one's eyes from

the cheyzu d'hai alma and becomes included in the One

— and through which one receives from there the

mishpatim of the Torah; and therefore the Torah is

called mishpat.

And this is what our Sages of blessed memory stated: that three things come

through yisoorim [sufferings], and they are: Torah,

the Land of Israel [Eretz Yisrael], and the World

to Come [Olam ha-Ba].

[Berachos 5a]

For all is one: for the World to Come is the

tachlis — when there will be fulfilled:

“On that day Hashem will be One and His Name will

be One”

[Zechariah 14:9] — that all will be

entirely good, entirely One, as above; and it is impossible to merit this except

through yisoorim, through which one closes one's eyes

from the cheyzu d'hai alma, as above. And this is also

the aspect of Torah — for from there comes the entire reception of the Torah:

from the reshimu of the

bitul mentioned above, which comes through the

yisoorim, as above. And this is also the aspect of

Eretz Yisrael [the Land of Israel] — for in

the Land of Israel is the primary sanctified place wherein one merits to properly

nullify oneself and draw from there the light of the

reshimu mentioned above and bind it within one's

heart properly. For in order to receive the Torah from the radiance of the

reshimu mentioned above and bind it within one's

heart properly — for this, one needs to sanctify the body through Torah and

mitzvos; and according to the holiness of the body, so does one merit to

bind [the reshimu] within one's heart, as above. And similarly, one needs

the holiness of place, which is

Eretz Yisrael — and therefore one who dwells

in the Land of Israel is likened to one who has a G-d

[Kesuvos 110b], for the primary sparkling of His

blessed Divinity that is drawn from the radiance of the

reshimu mentioned above is [found] in the Land of

Israel. And therefore, the entire book of Devarim [Deuteronomy] speaks

extensively in praise of the Land of Israel — for the primary fulfillment of

the Torah that is drawn from the radiance mentioned above is in the Land of Israel

— and therefore one must endure yisoorim before

arriving in the Land of Israel, for the

bitul mentioned above, from which the

reshimu mentioned above shines, comes through

yisoorim, as above.

And this is [the meaning of]:

“And Hashem shall guard for you the covenant and

the kindness [chessed] that He swore to your forefathers”

— “shall guard”

precisely [dayka] — meaning that

Hashem blessed-be-He will guard the chessed so that

it flows upon us in a manner in which we can receive it, so that the excess of

chessed should not harm us, G-d protect us, as above.

And therefore, even though He has already sworn to our forefathers to do

chessed with us, nonetheless it is impossible to

receive it except by fulfilling:

“And it shall come to pass, because

[ekev] you hearken” etc., as above — that we hear all

the mishpatim of the Torah within the

ragley [feet] — in the aspect of

“my foot stands on level ground”

[Psalms 26:12] — meaning within the

mammon that is called

ragley — meaning that we should be firm in

fulfilling the Torah and mitzvos to such a degree that

mammon will not cause us to transgress the Torah,

G-d protect us. For in the desire for

mammon lies the primary danger lest one forget

Hashem blessed-be-He through an abundance of money, as it is written:

“and silver and gold will multiply for you and

your heart will become haughty and you will forget Hashem” etc.

[Deuteronomy 8:13–14]; and as it is

written [in the beginning of Devarim]:

“v'di zahav”

[and abundant gold] — as our Sages of blessed memory expounded there

[Deuteronomy 1:1, Berachos 32a].

But if you merit to hear the mishpatim of the Torah

even in the aspect of the akavim [heels] and

ragley [feet] — meaning within the

mammon, as above — then:

“And Hashem shall guard for you the

chessed” — that no foreign [force] shall rule over it

— so that the abundance of chessed should not

harm you at all, G-d protect us. For “one who comes to purify himself

is aided”

[Shabbos 104a]. And since you strengthen yourself

to remember Hashem blessed-be-He even within [the domain of]

mammon, Hashem blessed-be-He will also guard the

chessed for you — meaning He will pour upon you

the flow of chessed with great watchfulness, in a

manner that will not harm you at all — in the aspect of:

“May Hashem bless you” — with

mammon;

“and guard you” — from the

destructive forces [mazeekay alma], so that the

destructive forces of the world should not gain hold of you through an abundance of

mammon, G-d protect us

[Numbers 6:24 — the Priestly Blessing, as expounded

by our Sages] — and then

precisely:

segments.he: וזה בחי' אכיל תשבת שהיא יקרה מאד כי שבת הואבחי' בושה ותשובה וע"כ אז האכילה הוא בקדושה גדולה מאד וזוכין על ידה לחים נצחיים של עוה"ב כנ"ל. וע"כ עיקר עונג שבת הוא האכילה של שבת כי בשבת צריכין דייקא לאכול כי ע"י אכילת שבת דייקא זוכין לחיים נצחיים כנ"ל. כי שבת היא בח' עוה"ב בחי' טועמי' חיים זכו כ"ש שם. ועל ידי אכילת שבת נתוסף חים בחינות חיים אמתיים חיים נצחיים של עוה"ב בחינו שפלות כנ"ל. והבן היטב. בילא"ו:
segments.en:
“and He will love you and bless you and multiply

you, and bless the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your land” etc.

[Deuteronomy 7:13] — for He will pour upon

you all goodness, since you will be capable of receiving the abundant flow of

chessed through the rectification of the vessels,

as above.

🌿 Translator's Summary — Likutay Halachos, Yoreh Dayah, Laws of Milah 5 (continued) — Avadim

Picking up immediately after section 8 (§ ח) of Milah 5, the author bridges

to the Shulchan Aruch's laws of circumcision of slaves (SA YD

Hilchos Milah 5:9). This is a characteristic move in Likutay Halachos: the same

kabbalistic framework that illuminated one halacha is now extended to shed light on an adjacent

one, revealing the inner unity of the entire Shulchan Aruch.

The slave as monetary extension: The master is obligated to circumcise his

slave because the slave is his kinyan kaspo (monetary acquisition). This halacha

becomes a gateway to the deepest teaching of the section: the

zuhamas ha-nachash (spiritual filth of the serpent)

grips most intensely not in the body generally, but specifically in the domain of

mammon (money/wealth). Within mammon reside all thirty-nine

melachos (creative labors) that flowed from Adam's sin — and these

thirty-nine melachos, driven by financial desire, are the precise opposite of

bitul. Therefore, no rectification of vessels is complete without purifying this

monetary dimension — represented by the slave.

The Kohen's slave and terumah: The rule that a

Kohen's slave may eat terumah and kodashim (which even ordinary

Israelites may not) is decoded: the Kohen's entire Temple service is the

rectification of the thirty-nine melachos — i.e., the domain of

mammon. Since the slave is the Kohen's monetary extension

(kaspo), and the Kohen has achieved vessel-rectification at this level,

the slave shares in the capacity to receive holy food without harm.

Shema and me'odecha: The word me'odecha

("with all your very much / all your resources") is understood as mammon. The

sequence Shema → bitul → V'ahavta / me'odecha

maps the process: first nullify into the One, then bind the reshimu into one's

heart and soul — and finally into one's financial domain. This is the last and most

difficult frontier of rectification.

Torah, Eretz Yisrael, and Olam ha-Ba through suffering:

These three (Berachos 5a) all come through yisoorim because suffering forces

the closing of eyes from cheyzu d'hai alma — producing the

bitul from which the reshimu shines. All three are in truth one

single process of inclusion in the tachlis.

"And Hashem will guard for you the chessed" — the word

"guard" (v'shamar) is read dayka (precisely/specifically): He will

guard the chessed so it does not overwhelm unready vessels. When a person

succeeds in remembering Hashem even within mammon (the ekev/heels),

Hashem reciprocates by pouring chessed in a guarded manner that will not harm

— culminating in the Priestly Blessing: "May Hashem bless you [with

mammon] and guard you [from the destructive forces that cling to mammon]."

Bitul / Yisoorim

Eyes sealed from this world

Reshimu shines

Torah & da'as

Purify mammon

Bind reshimu in me'odecha

Vessels rectified

39 melachos sanctified

Chessed guarded & poured

All blessing without harm
